stable.notes: Fork a session to another platform: in Work's Agent workspace, Fork to Claude or Codex (OpenAI) starts a new session there with your reviewed context and the conversation so far, read from the original session's transcript. The original session is unchanged. Saved meetings under review now get a suggestion to continue, fork or start a session, as tasks do. Pairs with server 6.57.1.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
